map.瞳孔(对光反射)反应分级器 使用指南: Pupil (Light Reflex) Reaction Grader User Guide
map.瞳孔对光反射分级器对直接反射与 RAPD 进行分级，辅助定位视神经传入或动眼神经: The pupil light reflex grader grades both the direct reflex and RAPD, helping localize optic nerve afferent or oculomotor efferent defects, which suits neuro-ophthalmic examination reference.
map.直接反射 = 光照该眼的反应: Direct reflex = the response when that eye is illuminated
map.直接对光 0–4 级、RAPD 0–4+ 分级。: Direct light reflex graded 0-4 and RAPD graded 0-4+.
map.相对性传入性瞳孔障碍（RAPD）定侧。: Relative afferent pupillary defect (RAPD) for lateralization.
map.视神经与视路病变筛查。: Optic nerve and visual pathway lesion screening.
map.：右眼直接反应减弱（2<3），RAPD 阳性定侧右眼（OD<OS），提示右眼视神: The right direct response is reduced (2 < 3) and RAPD is positive lateralizing to the right eye (OD < OS), indicating right optic nerve afferent damage.
map.：双侧正常、无 RAPD，瞳孔通路完整。: Both sides normal with no RAPD, so the pupillary pathway is intact.
map.交替光照双眼，患侧眼由暗转亮时仍散大（相对），即阳性。: Alternate light between the eyes; when the affected eye goes from dark to bright it still dilates (relatively), which is a positive result.
map.RAPD 见于哪些病？: In Which Diseases Does RAPD Appear?
map.视神经炎、显著视神经压迫、视网膜病变等单侧传入损害。: Optic neuritis, significant optic nerve compression and retinal lesions produce unilateral afferent defects.
